lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: You narrate part 9 of a comedy mini-series about Tolyan, a young used-car flipper growing his capital. Deadpan, dry irony; numbers said fully. «Мерседес сто двадцать четыре» is the Mercedes W124, a classic car.

tolyan.profile: Tolyan — a cocky Russian used-car flipper (perekup) in his 30s, street swagger, deep raspy voice, show-off, calls everyone «брат». Adult street comedy.
tolyan.notes: Line 1: respectful but excited, revealing the real price. Line 2: cocky, happy, phones are ringing.

ildar.profile: Ildar — an energetic Russian school PE teacher in his 30s in a tracksuit and a white cap, loud and cheerful, calls everyone «брат».
ildar.notes: Line 1: loud, amazed, gossiping. Line 2: shocked, shouting across the stadium.

dir.profile: Viktor Andreevich — a polite, formal Russian school headmaster in his 50s in a suit, a bit pompous, official tone.
dir.notes: Line 1: formal, a bit embarrassed, slow; the last word «ведро» said with hurt pride. Line 2: formal, touched, official tone, small pause after «Анатолий».

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: One line: loud, excited, bragging; «Студент» as a mocking nickname for the young rival; «кабан» is slang for the Mercedes W124.
